# Pentehouse — Barbearia no Marquês, Porto

> Pentehouse (also written "Pente House") is a barbershop in Marquês, Porto, Portugal, open since 2018. Haircuts, beard work and men's grooming with clear prices, online booking and walk-ins. Slogan: "Stay Clean".
> Not to be confused with the barbershop of a similar name in Vila Nova de Gaia — this is the Marquês, Porto house.

## Location
- Rua da Constituição 656, Loja 20, 4200-194 Porto
- Marquês area, a few minutes on foot from Metro Marquês station
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Pentehouse%20Porto&query_place_id=ChIJgdPqtldlJA0RcfObBuHD4rk

## Contact and booking
- Phone / WhatsApp: +351 916 605 673
- Online booking: https://pentehouse.pt/#marcar
- Walk-ins are accepted; booking ahead guarantees the slot and the barber.
- Barbers: Rascal (founder and barber), Grenha, Bruno Waya — clients can choose their barber when booking.

## Services and prices
- Cabelo (haircut and finish): 13,50 €
- Cabelo + Barba (full combo): 16 €
- Corte de criança (kids' cut): 11 €
- Barba (beard and finish): 6 €
- Relaxamento capilar: 6 €
- Contornos: 5 €
- Pera e bigode (goatee and moustache): 3 €
- Sobrancelhas (eyebrows): 2,50 €

## Hours
- Monday to Friday: 10:00–20:00
- Saturday: 10:00–18:00

## Payments
- Cash, MB WAY, bank transfer and Revolut transfer.
